event.comment: Approved with an amendment: deleted links must also stop redirecting immediately when cached (added FR-3). Re-plan downstream work.

event.title: Where to enforce expiry
event.choice: Re-check expiry on every lookup in LinkResolver, using the cached expiresAt
event.rationale: Correct at the exact instant, O(1), no database access on hits
alternatives: Per-entry Caffeine expiry (correct but relies on the cache ticker, not the application Clock, which makes it hard to test)
Shorter TTL (reduces but does not remove the window)

event.title: Schema change
event.choice: New V2 migration with a partial index
event.rationale: Applied migrations are immutable; partial index keeps it small
alternatives: Edit V1 (rejected: breaks Flyway checksums in existing environments)

event.title: Expired entry handling
event.choice: Invalidate the entry when found expired
event.rationale: Frees memory early; next lookup hits the database once and returns 410

event.comment: Approved after reviewing the patch, the V2 migration and the traceability matrix.
